svg.title: Focused backend validation matrix
svg.desc: A scoped go-pherence validation matrix showing current package labels for tensor references, loaders, SIMD, NVIDIA, Vulkan, SpacemiT, and integration smokes. Statuses include text badges so they do not rely on color alone.
svg.text: Scoped parity and smoke coverage for the active backend-related packages; not a repository-wide test count.

g.text: Gated = runtime, device, or platform dependent; partial = intentionally limited or still-warning surfaces.

svg.text: Reference owner for later backend compares
Directory selection, mmap, and shard metadata
GGUF tensors, quant blocks, and sidecar loading
RMSNorm, RoPE, SiLU, and GELU wrappers
GEMV, BF16, and quant helper dispatch
DevBuf, uploads, placement, and module load
PTX kernels for GEMM, GEMV, norm, and elementwise
Discovery, UUID, channel, and host-memory paths
Raw ioctl smoke and boundary tests
VA space and UVM edge cases
Dispatch wrappers and embedded SPIR-V plumbing
Boundary tests plus gated parity checks
RMSNorm, RoPEPartial, GELU, and attention score
Explicit wrapper path, not default LLM backend
RVV, IME2, AICPU, and board wiring
CPU decode, GGUF, and loader handoff
NVIDIA handoff and optional backend integration
Scope note: this matrix tracks backend validation focus and availability gates, not repository-wide package, test, or kernel totals.
